scope.description: Bounded official-source research outside Andalucía; three incident records, including independent Sierra Oeste claim check.
limitations: Search results used only for discovery; no incident facts admitted from snippets.
Current official page bodies and metadata verified; historical archived versions were not checked.
No private transcripts accessed. No existing dataset edited. No CEMS activation claims independently validated.

existing_dataset_review.scope: Only Madrid/Sierra Oeste fields and its Madrid and Moncloa source dates independently checked. Andalucía entries outside assigned scope.
